fields.details: Name of organisation: McKinnon Institute for Political Leadership
Name of program: Advanced Political Leadership 2025
Cost: The total cost of the program is $32,000 (plus GST).

BACKGROUND: Participants are provided with a full scholarship funded by the McKinnon Institute, covering the costs of tuition, induction, residential intensive and workshop (accommodation for 7-9 nights) and all meals and refreshments.

Advanced Political Leadership is a cohort based, face-to-face program designed to help MPs prepare for ministerial life, and enhance impact and influence through their career. The curriculum is practical and applied, and challenges participants to prepare for their future roles through a combination of self-reflection, structured small group work and whole-of-cohort dialogues.

APL is a non-partisan program bringing together MPs from the federal, state and territory parliaments. It is expected that participants will have had no or minimal ministerial experience and have reasonable prospects for a ministerial career.
